newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds steady in active forward trade.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds steady in active forward trade.

text.p: UK meals and feeds traders reported steady values and active trading in forward high protein soymeal on Thursday.
"There has been quite a bit going on in May/Oct high pro, it seems that some people felt Chicago was going to open sharply higher and now was a good time to buy," said one trader.
High protein soymeal was reported to have traded at 166 stg a tonne for May/Oct a number of times on the east coast.
In other business A.D.M. rapemeal fetched 124 stg for Nov on the resale market.
